children: Quantity is entered as units. Legacy pack-formatted imports remain readable for compatibility, but new stock uses the unit-only workflow. One item per line is recommended; semicolons also work. Optional columns 8–9 control Quantity Pricing: use bundle quantity + bundle price to enable it, or put OFF in column 8 to disable it for an existing product. Leave both blank to preserve an existing product’s current rule. The old comma format is still accepted.
